title: ValueTracker
author: DeepBuild
description: ValueTracker(value) as a named value, data/<id>.value: a formula reads it through its vars and a cue keys it (set_value over a play), so whatever reads it follows in closed form; an updater that reads it is code and has no mapping.

refuses.add_updater: An updater is code with no closed form: read the value through a formula's vars, or drive it with a driver (driver@1), or bake the frames with the bake route.
